div.div:
LEGEND & LAYERS
• Black solid (2.5 px): primary compass/passage movement (double arrowhead = two-way)
• Blue solid (2.8 px): vertical UPWAR / DOWN shaft (distinct from compass N/S)
• Purple dashed: magic word / special transition · Local markers: yellow = cross-page · orange = transient · red = death
• Optional layer [Parser Aliases / Fast Travel] (hidden by default): non-adjacent keyword shortcuts

text.tspan: • Black solid (2.5 px): primary compass/passage movement (double arrowhead = two-way)
• Blue solid (2.8 px): vertical UPWAR / DOWN shaft (distinct from compass N/S)
• Purple dashed: magic word / special transition · Local markers: yellow = cross-page · orange = transient · red = death
• Optional layer [Parser Aliases / Fast Travel] (hidden by default): non-adjacent keyword shortcuts

EXITS (source precedence order)
1. DOWN → LOC_CLIFFBASE
2. UPWAR → LOC_CLIFFTOP [carry RABBITFOOT]
3. UPWAR → LOC_FOOTSLIP [Ch 11]

div.div:
LOC_CLIFFBASE — at base of cliffYou are at the base of a nearly vertical cliff. There are some
slim footholds which would enable you to climb up, but it looks
extremely dangerous. Here at the base of the cliff lie the remains
of several earlier adventurers who apparently failed to make it.
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. DOWN, SE → LOC_STEEP
2. UPWAR, CLIMB → LOC_CLIFFACE

There is a low crawl leading off to the northeast.

1. CLIMB, DOWN → LOC_CLIFFACE
2. NE, CRAWL → LOC_REACHDEAD

div.div:
LOC_CLIFFTOP — LOC_CLIFFTOPJust as you reach the top, your foot slips on a loose rock and you
make one last desperate grab. Your luck holds, as does your grip.
With an enormous heave, you lift yourself to the ledge above.
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. (implicit) → LOC_CLIFFLEDGE

div.div:
LOC_MIRRORCANYON — in Mirror CanyonYou are in a north/south canyon about 25 feet across. The floor is
covered by white mist seeping in from the north. The walls extend
upward for well over 100 feet. Suspended from some unseen point far
above you, an enormous two-sided mirror is hanging parallel to and
midway between the canyon walls. (The mirror is obviously provided
for the use of the dwarves who, as you know, are extremely vain.) A
small window can be seen in either wall, some fifty feet up.
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. SOUTH → LOC_SECRET1 [Ch 05]
2. NORTH, RESER → LOC_RESERVOIR

div.div:
LOC_RESBOTTOM — at bottom of reservoirYou are walking across the bottom of the reservoir. Walls of water
rear up on either side. The roar of the water cascading past is
nearly deafening, and the mist is so thick you can barely see.
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. NORTH → LOC_RESNORTH
2. SOUTH → LOC_RESERVOIR

div.div:
LOC_RESERVOIR — at reservoirYou are at the edge of a large underground reservoir. An opaque cloud
of white mist fills the room and rises rapidly upward. The lake is
fed by a stream, which tumbles out of a hole in the wall about 10 feet
overhead and splashes noisily into the water somewhere within the
mist. There is a passage going back toward the south.
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. SOUTH, OUT → LOC_MIRRORCANYON
2. NORTH, ACROS, CROSS ✕ msg BAD_DIRECTION [not RESER=WATERS_PARTED]
3. NORTH → LOC_RESBOTTOM

div.div:
LOC_WINDOW2 — at window on pitYou're at a low window overlooking a huge pit, which extends up out of
sight. A floor is indistinctly visible over 50 feet below. Traces of
white mist cover the floor of the pit, becoming thicker to the left.
Marks in the dust around the window would seem to indicate that
someone has been here recently. Directly across the pit from you and
25 feet away there is a similar window looking into a lighted room. A
shadowy figure can be seen there peering back at you.
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. WEST → LOC_THREEJUNCTION [Ch 05]
2. JUMP → LOC_NECKBROKE [Ch 11]
